_require/_member_roles gate editing to PI (and admin), screening/enrolment/forms to DATA_ROLES, export to EXPORT_ROLES — exercised across tests.

export(shape='wide') de-identifies by excluding patient_name and converting dates to days-from-anchor — wide CSV assertion confirms patient_name not present.
DELETE /studies/{id}/screening/exclude uses query params (procedure_id, tooth_number) — matches the review-request contract and the test passes.

Code conflict in test_research_module.py fixture: `int(time.time()) % 100000` can collide when the two files run in the same second — handled by cleaning up Mongo T* leftovers between runs; the iter444 file uses the same scheme and ran clean after cleanup. Consider using uuid4().hex[:5] for truly unique codes if both files are routinely co-run.

research.py registry levels: patient-level values are persisted in research_patient_values (per patient+timepoint, D2) and hydrated into every enrolment for that patient — verified via dashboard/export without exceptions.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seeds. Each test run creates a draft study (code T<ts%100000>) via template cbl_immediate_maxillary_anterior, activates it with ethics fields, uses it, then archives+deletes. Direct Mongo cleanup of code-prefix T* studies/enrolments between runs to avoid code-collision across the two test files.
